questions.questionText: Why did Aya record both positions?

options.text: Because the creek may have moved over time
Because Aya was unsure how to read a map

questions.passage: The old survey marked the creek well east of where Aya found it. Rather than assume the survey was wrong, Aya recorded both positions and noted the date. Creeks move; records should say when they were made.
